Private Function T(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, lo As Object, lo2 As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("h1", "h2"), Array(3, 4), Array(1, 2), Array(5, 6))))
    ws.Range("A1:B4").AutoFilter 1, ">1"
    ws.Range("E1:F3").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("x", "y"), Array(1, 2), Array(3, 4))))
    Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("E1:F3"), , xlYes)
    lo.ShowTotals = True
    ws.Range("H1:I3").Value = ws.Range("E1:F3").Value
    Set lo2 = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("H1:I3"), , xlYes)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        T = TypeName(ws.Range("A1:B2,D4").Areas.Parent)
    Case 1
        T = ws.Range("A1:B2,D4").Areas.Parent.Address
    Case 2
        T = TypeName(ws.Range("A1:B2,D4").Areas.Application)
    Case 3
        T = TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Filters.Parent)
    Case 4
        T = TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Filters.Application)
    Case 5
        T = TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Application)
    Case 6
        T = TypeName(Application.WorksheetFunction.Parent)
    Case 7
        T = TypeName(Application.WorksheetFunction.Application)
    Case 8
        T = TypeName(ws.ListObjects.Application)
    Case 9
        T = TypeName(lo.ListColumns.Application)
    Case 10
        T = TypeName(lo.ListRows.Application)
    Case 11
        T = TypeName(lo.ListColumns(1).Application)
    Case 12
        T = TypeName(lo.ListColumns(1).Total)
    Case 13
        T = lo.ListColumns(2).Total.Address
    Case 14
        T = lo.ListColumns(2).Total.Formula
    Case 15
        T = TypeName(lo2.ListColumns(1).Total)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    T = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & T(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
